explanation: Combine two zero-based source draws into a uniform state in 0..24. Accept states below 21 and map each group of seven uniformly into 1..7.
correctness: Each pair is one of 25 equally likely states. Accepting 21 states leaves three representatives for each remainder modulo seven, so each result has conditional probability 1/7.
walkthrough: For injected draws 5,5,1,1, the first pair creates state (5-1)*5+(5-1)=24, which is rejected. The next pair creates state 0 and returns 1. Among accepted states 0..20, each remainder modulo seven occurs three times, giving probability 1/7 for each output. The displayed true reports the judge properties.
edgeCases: no modulo bias from all 25 states.
timeComplexity: O(1) expected time (50/21 source draws); unbounded worst-case draws.
